positive_cases.case: one row of cutters on one metal body
positive_cases.expect: one cut preview per selected metal body with removed_mm3 > 0

positive_cases.input: a row plus one metal body
positive_cases.expect: one CutterCut per target; Enter replaces each body in the same transaction
om9.cutter.cut records kind, row and preserve; no cutter body is inserted
the metal bodies and the cutter bodies return to the pre-command state

negative_cases.case: a cutter that misses the target
negative_cases.input: a block far from the metal

limitations: The Boolean reuses the one mesh CSG service (mesh_csg::mesh_boolean); it never runs OCCT inside the adapter.
Every target must be a closed mesh body; a surface body is refused instead of silently meshed.
The cut is applied in world space, so a row cut through several bodies is one transaction but not one CSG union.
